blockingRootCauseId.description: Stable id/root-cause label of the worst-severity merge-gating finding (NOT surface text), so the same blocker is recognized across loops. Empty when there is no blocking finding.

escalationReason.description: When escalation=escalate: the specific human-actionable decision/blocker/dead-end (never a bare 'stuck'). Empty when keep_going.

reasoning.description: Cite the BLOCKING root cause + the finding-delta across loops: which root causes were retired, which recurred, and whether the total P-score is decreasing.
